paragraphs.text: The Chorus of the Conclave was a collective mind of Dryads on Ravnica that at one point led the Selesnya Conclave .
The guild leader of Selesnya before the Decamillennial was at one point the collective mind of Dryads known as the Chorus of the Conclave, with the top members of the guild as figureheads.

After the Decamillennial when the Chorus was killed by Szadek 's murder of Savra vod Savo , the Selesnya gradually lost their connection to the World Tree and had to rely on their high priests organized as the high council.
